# Buy Unlocked

> Unlocked phones. Any carrier. Buy Unlocked is an online store, launching soon, for unlocked phones from Samsung, Google Pixel, Motorola, OnePlus, TCL and Apple, sold new, open-box and certified pre-owned (CPO), plus "Unlocked" bundles that pair a phone or phone accessories with something new to do. Buy Unlocked is a brand of LEK Telecom LLC, a Colorado company based in Denver.

Brand line: "Freedom is the feature." Unlocked phones work on any carrier, prepaid or postpaid, at home or abroad. The store is not open for orders yet; visitors can join the email list to hear first.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://buyunlocked.net/): Unlocked phones by brand and condition, the Unlocked bundles, email sign-up and partnership info
- [Will it work?](https://buyunlocked.net/checker.html): Pick an unlocked phone and a US carrier (AT&T, T-Mobile, Verizon or Boost) to see whether it should work before you buy, including international models
- [About](https://buyunlocked.net/about.html): Who runs Buy Unlocked (LEK Telecom LLC) and why
- [Buy Unlocked vs. Google](https://buyunlocked.net/buy-unlocked-vs-google): How buying an unlocked phone from Buy Unlocked compares with the Google Store, including when Google is the better pick
- [Buy Unlocked vs. Samsung](https://buyunlocked.net/buy-unlocked-vs-samsung): How buying an unlocked phone from Buy Unlocked compares with Samsung.com, including when Samsung is the better pick
- [Links](https://buyunlocked.net/links/): All Buy Unlocked pages and social channels in one place

## Unlocked bundles

- [Game Unlocked](https://buyunlocked.net/game-unlocked.html): Kit for mobile gamers with a phone cooler, magnetic ring, finger sleeves, a 6 ft right-angle USB-C cable and a mystery "Loot Drop" NFC charm. Ages 13+. The first bundle to launch; coming soon
- [Travel Unlocked](https://buyunlocked.net/travel-unlocked.html): Bundle for international trips with an unlocked phone, a travel eSIM for data abroad and open-ear earbuds, with live translation built into the phone and no subscription. Coming soon
- Power Unlocked: An unlocked phone with portable power. Coming soon
- Wellness Unlocked: An unlocked phone with wellness wearables. Coming soon

## Partners

OEMs, distributors, carriers and MVNOs, and accessory and service brands can partner with Buy Unlocked on co-branded bundles, BYOD and activation programs, and direct-to-consumer launches. Contact: hello@buyunlocked.net (subject "Buy Unlocked partnership").
